newsitem.title: USA: ReliaStar agrees to buy Citizens.
newsitem.headline: ReliaStar agrees to buy Citizens.

text.p: ReliaStar Financial Corp said Wednesday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Citizens Community Bancshares Co, the parent company of Citizens Savings Bank of St. Cloud, Minn.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
ReliaStar said the transaction will not have a material financial effect on it and will be non-dilutive to earnings per share.
ReliaStar said it expects the transaction to close in the third quarter, subject to regulatory approval.
Citizens Savings Bank had $40 million in assets at year-end 1996.
ReliaStar said it intends to sell Citizens bank products through its existing distribution channels.
